note: Continuity is stated as the abstract `Curve` condition over a fixed finite address set, and covariance as the `Moves` datum, rather than as continuity of the weighted difference sums. The final assertion holds on the allowed band under `Allows` and `Approved`.

lemma curve (ht : b.threshold ≤ threshold G b.order b.power) (hc : c.direct ≤ 1) (hX : ∀ x∈X, 0 ≤ x) :
    Curve b (Bid.Cake (payload c b G n) (dictionary G n) (top G c) c b) X := by
  refine ⟨continuousOn_id,continuousOn_const, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl,fun ε he x hx => ?_⟩
  have hf := (show Continuous (totalE n c G b x) by unfold totalE BudgetPoint.mass weight; fun_prop).tendsto' x 0
    (by simp [totalE,BudgetPoint.mass])
  have hg := (show Continuous (totalK n b x) by unfold totalK BudgetPoint.mass; fun_prop).tendsto' x 0 (by simp [totalK,BudgetPoint.mass])
  filter_upwards [(hf.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).eventually (gt_mem_nhds he), (hg.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).eventually (gt_mem_nhds he),self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hy' hyx
  let p := ‖weight c x-weight c y‖ * item G b
  let q := ‖x-y‖ * total n
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (item_pos ..).le
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (total_pos ..).le
  refine ⟨fun i => if fixed (Sheet n) i then p else 0, fun i => if fixed (Foot n) i then q else 0, fun i => ?_,fun i => ?_,
    Padded.budget (α:=Sheet n) (fun i => ?_) (fun i => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hp) hy.le,
    Padded.budget (α:=Foot n) (fun i => ?_) (fun i => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hq) hy'.le⟩
  · simp only [Bid.Cake,pours,dictionary,payload]; split
    · exact differenceE ht _
    exact ⟨le_rfl,fun _ _ _ _ _ => by simp⟩
  · simp only [Bid.Cake,pours,dictionary,payload]; split
    · exact ⟨hq,paid_dist hc (hX x hx) (hX y hyx) _⟩
    exact ⟨le_rfl,fun _ => by simp⟩
  · dsimp only; split <;> first | rfl | exact mul_zero _
  · dsimp only; split <;> first | rfl | exact mul_zero _

proof_context.conclusion: `Curve` for the start family: continuity in `beta` of the regular and forced activities within the budgets `totalE` and `totalK` (finite sums over `Sheet n` and `Foot n`).

theorem moves (s : Signed) (x : Site n) (β : ℝ) : Nonempty ((raw G n c b β).Moves s x) := by
  refine ⟨{ ep := sends (sheetAction s x), kp := sends (footAction s x), reg_site := fun i => ?_,reg_support := fun i => ?_,
            forced_support := fun i => ?_,forced_inventory := fun i => ?_,forced_tests := fun i U => Iff.rfl,
            valuesE := fun i U => ?_,valuesK := fun i U => ?_ }⟩
  · change (eInfo _).site = affine s x (eInfo _).site
    rw [name_sends,eInfo_transport]
  · change (eInfo _).support = Finset.image _ (eInfo _).support
    rw [name_sends,eInfo_transport]
  · change (name (Foot n) _).val.1 = (name (Foot n) i).val.1.image _
    rw [name_sends,foot_trans]
  · change (name (Foot n) _).val.2 = (name (Foot n) i).val.2.image _
    rw [name_sends,foot_trans]
  · simp only [raw,pours,payload,name_sends,fixed_sends]
    split <;> first | exact written_oriented .. | exact rfl
  · simp only [raw,pours,payload,name_sends,fixed_sends]
    split <;> first | exact paid_oriented .. | exact rfl

proof_context.conclusion: Translations and signed permutations act on labels, supports, inventories, tests and values (`written_oriented`, `paid_oriented`): `Moves s x` is nonempty.

theorem oust (N p : ℕ) (h : Approved B N) (a : Allows B.a N) : Bid.Oust B N p := by
  let b := B.a.budget N
  let X := band B.a N
  let n := B.a.S.side N p
  let c := (B.a.params N).clip
  obtain ⟨σ,κ,γ,he,hh⟩ := a.receipt
  have ht : b.threshold ≤ threshold G b.order b.power := a.radius
  refine ⟨dictionary G n,payload c b G n,enumeration G n,?_⟩
  have hX (x) (hx : x∈X) : B.a.clock.hatBeta N/2 ≤ x := hx.1
  dsimp only
  change ((Curve b (Cake _ _ (B.bake.path N N) c b) X ∧ _ ∧ _) ∧ _)
  simp only [h.paths,topRatio]
  refine ⟨⟨curve ht a.clip.direct (fun x hx => he.slope.trans (hX x hx)),posed a.clip.direct (fun x hx => he.slope.trans (hX x hx)),he.little a.clip X hX⟩,fun x hx =>
    ⟨(h.passes p x hx).symm,κ,Real.exp γ-1,Real.exp γ-1, digests a.clip ht he (hX x hx) ?_,he.buys a.clip (hX x hx),hh,fun y => ?_⟩⟩
  · refine le_trans ?_ a.income
    unfold book overhead
    have h₁ := item_pos G b
    have ht : ‖x‖ ≤ 2*B.a.clock.hatBeta N := by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (he.slope.trans (hX x hx))]; exact hx.2
    gcongr
  simp only [payload,Pi.zero_apply,tsum_zero,Real.exp_zero,mul_one]; exact evaluates a.clip y

proof_context.conclusion: Assembles the curve, its bounds and the evaluation to the bare weight `e^{-beta E}` over the coupling band.
